suite: XD-TAU v1.4 CSG independent regression evidence

proof_scope.general_theorems: Analytical proofs belong in the document; finite checks do not prove the full architecture.

prior_construction_correction.replacement: Equality holds under strict differentiability, including C1 regularity in a neighborhood.
